g.text: The public observatory for the factory: dated project dossiers, dispatches, architecture,
incidents and a bounded agent-readable view.
Every project carries its own review date.
Snapshots are labelled snapshots; private issue text stays private.
Agent Reception publishes a bounded public-safe summary.
A project in context · public dossier artwork
D1 editorial · R2 media · KV cache
Write the project record in EmDash.
Check public safety, rights and dates.
Render the edition from D1 and R2.
